You can export your complete chat history `directly from ChatGPT Settings`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-0-T0fWhLrk9qvZKFI21ZSX2EcHwqJ8s7fimyjNR9OcTlDg_x10Mz6Yjzu2xkjt3TPb-0KAUcBoPxY9-bSM6NSoohrYbZrlUYA_9Y93eMI-QRpXBRsPoXt8D5JzvUGMAzky9f3nDzDu3Loy51lpmzfKeQNJYCzAoihAUkxB9sHrDbaddZJ2klpX76U)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX5koNN2ubh2KvCSdxdiQzszGGaH15apUTBPaMVeP_ejrI-kBLeYWgtYZWXlbarlT9513d7l2LW0FKMCThzxuy2ktRTSzC0CK0Tt2zguS1Oa3chU1oSyrVeZ8hv4WyxZ0dfFc)

### How to Use Native Export (Official Method)

1. Go to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXX2mcWwlWKI9ACBj3ZtHGK4BFXoCWZKErVsEdPf65aNFTvgQWJpftro9fBGU6di-9qCgrm07CAKUnZI-7bbubTQPoRFANK7pbXoWaH) and sign in.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX5koNN2ubh2KvCSdxdiQzszGGaH15apUTBPaMVeP_ejrI-kBLeYWgtYZWXlbarlT9513d7l2LW0FKMCThzxuy2ktRTSzC0CK0Tt2zguS1Oa3chU1oSyrVeZ8hv4WyxZ0dfFc)
2. Click your **profile icon or name** in the bottom-left corner.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXs-UhfdJFqVOVpXZLLz_XOeyr3pdKCO82MXk7V0bL_UW0sGDCae1A4X3k6kAKnBdsIgMKs7YUASOUOjGtpV_Oab3GbgjJgi0YBmPhO_sPjY5vIt7g2APvYth3N5ZJipvY42c6FDJMnwuA9vqXZi4)
3. Select **Settings**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXs-UhfdJFqVOVpXZLLz_XOeyr3pdKCO82MXk7V0bL_UW0sGDCae1A4X3k6kAKnBdsIgMKs7YUASOUOjGtpV_Oab3GbgjJgi0YBmPhO_sPjY5vIt7g2APvYth3N5ZJipvY42c6FDJMnwuA9vqXZi4)
4. Choose **Data controls** on the left sidebar, then click **Export** next to "Export data".[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX5koNN2ubh2KvCSdxdiQzszGGaH15apUTBPaMVeP_ejrI-kBLeYWgtYZWXlbarlT9513d7l2LW0FKMCThzxuy2ktRTSzC0CK0Tt2zguS1Oa3chU1oSyrVeZ8hv4WyxZ0dfFc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXs-UhfdJFqVOVpXZLLz_XOeyr3pdKCO82MXk7V0bL_UW0sGDCae1A4X3k6kAKnBdsIgMKs7YUASOUOjGtpV_Oab3GbgjJgi0YBmPhO_sPjY5vIt7g2APvYth3N5ZJipvY42c6FDJMnwuA9vqXZi4)
5. Click **Confirm Export**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX5koNN2ubh2KvCSdxdiQzszGGaH15apUTBPaMVeP_ejrI-kBLeYWgtYZWXlbarlT9513d7l2LW0FKMCThzxuy2ktRTSzC0CK0Tt2zguS1Oa3chU1oSyrVeZ8hv4WyxZ0dfFc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXs-UhfdJFqVOVpXZLLz_XOeyr3pdKCO82MXk7V0bL_UW0sGDCae1A4X3k6kAKnBdsIgMKs7YUASOUOjGtpV_Oab3GbgjJgi0YBmPhO_sPjY5vIt7g2APvYth3N5ZJipvY42c6FDJMnwuA9vqXZi4)
6. Wait for an email or SMS from OpenAI with a download link (this can take up to 7 days, though it usually arrives within minutes).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-0-T0fWhLrk9qvZKFI21ZSX2EcHwqJ8s7fimyjNR9OcTlDg_x10Mz6Yjzu2xkjt3TPb-0KAUcBoPxY9-bSM6NSoohrYbZrlUYA_9Y93eMI-QRpXBRsPoXt8D5JzvUGMAzky9f3nDzDu3Loy51lpmzfKeQNJYCzAoihAUkxB9sHrDbaddZJ2klpX76U)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXs-UhfdJFqVOVpXZLLz_XOeyr3pdKCO82MXk7V0bL_UW0sGDCae1A4X3k6kAKnBdsIgMKs7YUASOUOjGtpV_Oab3GbgjJgi0YBmPhO_sPjY5vIt7g2APvYth3N5ZJipvY42c6FDJMnwuA9vqXZi4)
7. Click **Download data export** in the message. *Note: The link expires 24 hours after you receive it.* [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-0-T0fWhLrk9qvZKFI21ZSX2EcHwqJ8s7fimyjNR9OcTlDg_x10Mz6Yjzu2xkjt3TPb-0KAUcBoPxY9-bSM6NSoohrYbZrlUYA_9Y93eMI-QRpXBRsPoXt8D5JzvUGMAzky9f3nDzDu3Loy51lpmzfKeQNJYCzAoihAUkxB9sHrDbaddZJ2klpX76U)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX5koNN2ubh2KvCSdxdiQzszGGaH15apUTBPaMVeP_ejrI-kBLeYWgtYZWXlbarlT9513d7l2LW0FKMCThzxuy2ktRTSzC0CK0Tt2zguS1Oa3chU1oSyrVeZ8hv4WyxZ0dfFc)
8. Unzip the downloaded file to find your full chat history in `conversations.json` and a readable `chat.html` file.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXnmwwvK8_I0H06DsAZSIF3KTG1OMin_W75HlPacgPy6F92UTkkgqqQSXnWZkXiEK2EvOUH957oKtjMkRq1LBoEh-e57kmoQhVa49wyw20iWxKViUt4HvBuWzBK4WsC6OG4bY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXs-UhfdJFqVOVpXZLLz_XOeyr3pdKCO82MXk7V0bL_UW0sGDCae1A4X3k6kAKnBdsIgMKs7YUASOUOjGtpV_Oab3GbgjJgi0YBmPhO_sPjY5vIt7g2APvYth3N5ZJipvY42c6FDJMnwuA9vqXZi4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXhkmiLho8uDP6PtzPJRgCh9LS9o8FIC-pzYsmwgNl3EHma1t8Vm899FNUTQ7_magp-QuE_PxZLxQE0k_rg3jtMGHItDuwmTVjbheqVQ0VtcnFcK4uDortRsxZAtULYy0D3Yo)

### Alternative Methods

- **Single Conversation Share:** Open any chat, click the **Share** or **Copy link** option at the top to generate a read-only link.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXRYKSAeWdeuSeouyl5XEZME2yvyLbGPkgpck04BLHmAzFLlNyGpSWt0Msn8MCnShMdN7l7T4AQ9FgW66LgMtWvNEmoeAs_nV9Bg4HucMeygbvxCDSfvNxClpUQGMXOZJof-tbaTn1Jg)
- **Browser Extensions / Scripts:** Use tools like the [ExportGPT Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn) or open-source exporters like [GitHub - pionxzh/chatgpt-exporter](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXLLCDs_ypLeAIGqmupXkQOkCOWrWJkenPjRPVFc-1oSIBJ9PnI0w42FyMIXRTsKadPh-qkZDTKFdKePklWjGgZfrKRZGHeFP0RxFtGWrkqCKRJYVjoFlNXp55safOP9VKIHSf) to save chats locally as Markdown, PDF, HTML, or Excel with one click.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXLLCDs_ypLeAIGqmupXkQOkCOWrWJkenPjRPVFc-1oSIBJ9PnI0w42FyMIXRTsKadPh-qkZDTKFdKePklWjGgZfrKRZGHeFP0RxFtGWrkqCKRJYVjoFlNXp55safOP9VKIHSf)

If you'd like, let me know:

- **Why** you are exporting (backing up data, switching to another AI like Claude, or printing a specific chat)
- **What format** you prefer (JSON, Markdown, PDF, or HTML)

I can give you the exact steps or script for that setup.

items.text: Go to ChatGPT and sign in. Click your profile icon or name in the bottom-left corner. Select Settings. Choose Data controls on the left sidebar, then click Export next to "Export data". Click Confirm Export. Wait for an email or SMS from OpenAI with a download link (this can take up to 7 days, though it usually arrives within minutes). Click Download data export in the message. Note: The link expires 24 hours after you receive it. Unzip the downloaded file to find your full chat history in conversations.json and a readable chat.html file.

items.title: What people are saying

I am begging you, export your ChatGPT history this week.

You've spent years telling it about your projects, your health and how you write. All of that lives on OpenAI's servers.

If OpenAI locks, bans or loses your account, you lose those chats with it. You also can't move them to Claude, Gemini or a model on your own laptop.

In ChatGPT, open Settings → Data controls → Export data, and OpenAI emails you a zip of every chat. In Claude, you'll find the same button under Settings → Privacy.

Save the zip on your own drive. Then copy the parts that matter into one plain notes file, so any AI can read it, including the open source model you downloaded last weekend.

The export takes one click and a minute of your time.

Keep your AI memory on a drive you own.

Made a request for an export of all my ChatGPT data. Do I get my chat history from 2022?

You've probably pasted an API key, a password or even a seed phrase into ChatGPT "just to check something." It's all still sitting in your chat history.

Find it in 5 minutes:
1. Export your history (ChatGPT: Settings → Data controls → Export. Claude: Settings → Privacy → Export data)
2. Unzip it, open the folder in Claude Code and paste:

"Scan every conversation in this folder for secrets I pasted: API keys, passwords, private keys, seed phrases (12 or 24 English words in a row), card numbers and ID numbers. For each one, show the chat title, the date and only the first and last 4 characters. Group them into: rotate now, check, and false alarm. Never print a full secret and don't send anything online."

Then change everything in the "rotate now" list.
